items.title: Consistency of no amenable C-sequence with higher-order indescribability and non-ineffability in L
items.author: Gabriel Fernandes
items.difficulty_reason: Combines stationary Hechler capture, support localization and stationarity preservation to eliminate every amenable C-sequence along the iteration, while the full embedding-lift preparation preserves higher-order Pi-two-one indescribability and the ground-model least-cardinal argument preserves non-ineffability in L.
